motivation: Continuous physical profiling changes the score little. Energy at the known true cosmology also has excessive variation with Omega_m, suggesting learned null-score misspecification rather than mainly a discrete-grid artifact.
inputs: Per-map mean fitted standardized cosmology from the three frozen R3 summary networks. No true physical labels are used as prediction inputs.
target: Mean three-network continuous-profile energy, log transformed.
fit_data: 3232 normal validation realizations, which were previously used to select network checkpoints. Calibration and audit sets are not used to fit these regressors.
selection: Five folds grouped by known cosmology, fixed seed 4242. The frozen networks were trained using other maps from those same cosmologies; this validates the new calibrator, not the complete density pipeline on unseen cosmologies.
location: Polynomial degrees 0, 1, 2, 3 in two inferred physical coordinates. Ridge strengths 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10. Fit location by least squares; choose on normal held-out mean squared log-energy error.
scale: Optional polynomial predictor of log squared out-of-fold residual. Select the same degree/ridge grid on held-out Gaussian NLL of cross-fitted location residuals, with a fixed minimum SD of half the overall out-of-fold SD. Report constant scale as an explicit control. Scale uses out-of-fold location residuals; its CV is conditional on these already cross-fitted targets, not fully nested pipeline CV.
scores: Absolute standardized log energy, an exploratory two-sided typicality score
ensembles: Replace only the summary component in the existing equal-weight field hybrid and regional-max ensemble. Preserve field/regional networks and fit corrections. Recompute robust score scales on normal calibration data only.
checks: Pointwise singleton/order/chunk invariance; calibration-vs-audit false alarms by true physical parameters; all reused synthetic families including regressions; paired bootstrap is descriptive conditional on this search.
public_test: Not read. Existing 04/05/06/07 predictions are unchanged.
interpretation: Normal-trained heuristic score correction. It is not an exact conditional p-value, likelihood ratio, or proof of power for unknown physical anomalies. Conditioning may hide shifts that the inferred cosmology explains away.
